  fhir:purpose [ fhir:v "This extension is part of the cross-version definitions generated to enable use of the\r\nelement `TestPlan.testCase` as defined in FHIR R5\r\nin FHIR R4.\r\n\r\nThe source element is defined as:\r\n`TestPlan.testCase` 0..* `BackboneElement`\r\n\r\nAcross FHIR versions, the element set has been mapped as:\r\n* R5 `TestPlan.testCase` 0..* `BackboneElement`\r\n\r\nFollowing are the generation technical comments:\r\nElement `TestPlan.testCase` is not mapped to FHIR R4, since FHIR R5 `TestPlan` is not mapped.\nElement `TestPlan.testCase` has no mapping targets in FHIR R4.
